answer: Executed result (approximate; offline environment) — the most significantly enriched pathway is KEGG 'Ribosome' (NES = +2.24, enriched in UBE2M KD; BH-FDR q = 0.072, p = 0.004; leading edge n=6: Rpl41, Rpl18a, Rplp0, Rpl5, Rpl32, Rpl21). IMPORTANT CAVEAT: this is the output of my from-scratch prerank GSEA run on a knowledge-reconstructed KEGG_2019_Mouse library (~18 mouse pathways) with only ~1% of genes resolvable by a knowledge-based Ensembl→symbol bridge. None of the 18 tested pathways reached FDR<0.05, and the sandbox is fully offline (gseapy not installable; official KEGG_2019_Mouse not downloadable; no ID-mapping table on disk). This is therefore NOT an authoritative gseapy result — with genuine gseapy and the true library the top hit could differ (the UBE2M-KD biology points to the Nrf2/proteasome axis; the Proteasome set came up positive NES +1.71, FDR 0.169, also not significant). The DESeq2-like DE analysis itself is fully reproducible: 1,564 DEGs (p<0.05, |shrunk log2FC|>1, baseMean>10) = 870 up / 694 down in KD vs control.
